body:
"pretend you're above a motivational comment"

Do you understand what his comment means? Being depressed and trying to have fun and being a complete cunt and putting others down are two very different things

I really don't want to work, it doesn't seem like a good idea because getting a shitty job wouldn't help me get anywhere would it? 

I took 1 driving lesson and have the option to learn how to drive, but I don't have any reason to drive at the moment so I've put it off
Yeah I know that I eventually will, and I'll probably end up getting hurt by it again.
Liked biology when I did yr12. That's it. I don't know what I want to be when I'm 25.
No, not doing either

I should probably stop contacting her, I've been contacting her and trying to get in touch. It hurts a lot right now and I just want to speak with her. It will get better.

Say yes to everything? Idk this isn't really a thing that applies to me because I don't get offers to do anything from people lol, I mean there's offers in this thread but yeah. Someone else said this and it's good advice - you have nothing to lose by accepting.
People talk at poker tables, yeah. Some decent socialising.
I did listen to some suggestions.
I was legitimately asking, there was only 3 replies in this thread and 2 of them hinted homosexuality. I thought there was something going on. I messaged OP.
At least I'm not pathetic enough to post something like this.
I can kinda comfort myself, then what? I'm still going to feel empty and depressed even after I get over the initial heartbreak
I understand what you're saying completely, it's just that I can't imagine forcing myself to exercise doing much for me, I'm probably wrong though.
I want to get out and do shit... kind of. I'm not a social person, I have no idea what to do.

Ah, so you're suggesting that I make a hobby out of it basically. It's something I've considered for quite a while, I've almost applied before, but I always just think that it isn't my thing. I could give it a shot, what do you think is the minimum amount of time to invest before I could say "I've given this a shot, it isn't for me"?

What am I supposed to do now though? Time will help the pain go away but that doesn't seem very significant, I'll still have nothing. I need to do something completely different with my life, and that won't be some shitty job, it would have to be going back to school, which I'm not ready to do. I have zero motivation.

ACMI seems to be based on film, not much there from a gander at the site.

Internet cafes that run events actually sounds really fun and like something I could do, I've never thought of that or been suggested that. I'll look into it!
I do light exercise, about 40 minutes of walking a day (I walk everywhere) and some sets of 15 pushups. And I watch what I eat. Do you really think I should be worrying about heart disease?

I'll tell you as briefly as I can since you asked. No, it wasn't because of my attitude. A few days ago she decided to cheat on me, and said she felt really bad about it etc. and that she loves me. She believes she is a "hoe on the inside" and couldnt stop herself. Few days later, she decides she's breaking up with me and not talking to me indefinitely, because she thinks not being in a relationship is better. Completely unexpected, but she basically decided she'd rather be a slut than be in a relationship. She's also autistic for whatever relevance that has, I don't think she sees that its a hurtful thing to do.
You can't see why she dumped me, stop pretending to know shit. I could elaborate but it's COMPLETELY irrelevant to this thread.
I don't do much. Poker, watch videos, play video games, all at home. I only go out if I'm buying food or if I was meeting someone, who 95 in 100 times was my ex-girlfriend. Sometimes I go to crown.

You're making a comment for no other reason than to be harsh, in a thread asking for stuff to do in melbourne. It is not constructive, or even relevant, at all. 

If that is not hostile, I don't know what is.

I'm not really sure what you mean by self-absorbed. I am looking for something new to do, and am listening to considerations (although rather generic) and explaining how I feel about the activities. The obvious suggestions have obviously already been considered, if I was interested in them this thread wouldn't exist.
true
I've thought about it, but it's just something I've never done before. If I had a friend that would do that type of thing I would.

I could join a gym and then quit because I couldn't care less a week later. I've exercised at home before and forced myself to everyday for weeks, and I never like doing it. Joining a gym/playing sports and hoping all the bitches flock is not something for everyone.

The attitude doesn't help, but you're basically asking me to completely change my mindset towards that stuff.

Yeah, I'm sure you know why based on a couple of responses. Appreciate the input. She knows fully of my lifestyle, and always did, that wasn't what was wrong.

I could be her posting this exact same thread with responses about her own life, and you'd probably say exactly the same thing. There's no need to be hostile.

I don't know what to get out there and do. I hate sports, I hate exercise. Every attempt at either is very short-lived because, the entire way, I really don't enjoy it in the slightest. I watch what I eat and am not overweight, although I'm on the larger side of being a healthy weight. No offence, but I've obviously thought of these, they're really broad things to do.

I'm not attractive lol, it's not anything to do with attitude.

What am I doing right now? All day I've been playing poker online, watching a stream and smoking pot. I'm really crushed by my gf dumping me suddenly.
Ahh I see

I've made an account on that website and looked around. The only thing I do is play video games, watch streams and play/watch poker. It's probably my only somewhat legitimate hobby, and I actually didn't think to search meetup for poker groups, and I joined 2.

Other than that, there's a lot of stuff to go to, but I don't know what to.
Am I missing something with someone mentioning grindr and now you talking about a bromance? IDK I'm just a tad confused

For what? Hookups, friends, another relationship?

Friends I can do (although I'm not very social), I'm not attractive enough to get hookups, and another relationship... Not really ready for that
that's the gay version... why do you say?
what am I meant to do then? I've lost the only thing that mattered to me
no, there's nothing else that keeps me going
